summary: Cosy 3D Tulip Era garden builder, redesigned as a sunlit sandstone diorama with a garden-scroll UI, built by Claude Haiku 5.5 · Lale Devri'nde 3D bahçe kurma oyunu, güneşli kumtaşı diorama ve bahçe parşömeni arayüzüyle yeniden tasarlandı, Claude Haiku 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Plant bulbs, water and cut the blooms; two tulips blooming side by side breed a new variety (colour, petal shape, pattern)
Redesign: a sandstone diorama plinth with raised beds, tiered cypresses and planes, a stepped fountain, bees and lantern glow
Redesign: parchment garden-scroll panels with tulip-flourish corners on every screen; the garden starts with four beds and a one-line coach
A bazaar with tulip-mania price swings and a festival every 30 days scoring variety, colour harmony, symmetry and decoration
Measured after the redesign: 60 fps at 1280x720, 57-61 draw calls in the ?auto run, zero JS errors across every season

social.headline: Grow a tulip garden in the Ottoman Tulip Era: breed new varieties and win the Sultan's festival · Lale Devri'nde bahçe kur: yeni çeşitler melezle, Sultan'ın şenliğini kazan
